- **Memory Complexity:** The memory footprint is small, proportional to the size of one slice plus lower-dimensional footprints.
- **Limitations:** For data with high-frequency components or noise, the residuals may not be as compressible as with wavelet transforms.
- **When to use:** When data has high coherence in all dimensions and memory is constrained (out-of-core).
- **When not to use:** When maximum lossless compression ratio is required for 4D data and memory is not a constraint (wavelets may be slightly better).
